i0: A **phrasal verb** is a verb + a small word called a **particle** (*up, down, on, off, out, back, in, over*): *get **up**, turn **on**, look **after***. The particle often changes the meaning completely: *look* (see) / *look **for*** (try to find) / *look **after*** (take care of).
i1: Phrasal verbs are very common in everyday English, so learn them in **real sentences**, not as lists. This page also explains **word order**: *turn it on*, not *turn on it*.
phv-basic.t: Get up, turn on, put on, look for
phv-basic.s: Everyday phrasal verbs: **get up, wake up, sit down, stand up, turn on / off, put on, take off, look for, come back, go out**. The particle changes the meaning.
phv-basic.b0.3.1: start / stop a machine or light
phv-basic.b0.4.2: ***Put on** your coat. **Take off** your shoes.*
phv-basic.b1: In English, you **turn on** a light or a TV (not *open the light*), and you **put on** clothes before you wear them.
phv-separable.t: Turn it off, not turn off it: separable verbs
phv-separable.s: With many phrasal verbs, a **noun** can go **before or after** the particle (*turn off the TV / turn the TV off*), but a **pronoun** must go **in the middle**: *turn **it** off* (not *turn off it*).
phv-separable.b0.h: With a noun | With a pronoun
phv-separable.b0.0.0: *Turn on the TV.* / *Turn the TV on.*
phv-separable.b0.1.0: *Pick up your toys.* / *Pick your toys up.*
phv-separable.b0.2.0: *Fill in the form.* / *Fill the form in.*
phv-separable.b0.3.0: *Wake up the kids.* / *Wake the kids up.*
phv-separable.b1: Common separable phrasal verbs: *turn on / off, put on, take off, pick up, throw away, give back, fill in, write down, try on, put away, wake up* (someone), *call back*.
phv-separable.b2: A **pronoun** (*it, them, me, him, her, us*) always goes **between** the verb and the particle.
phv-inseparable.t: Look after her, get on the bus: inseparable verbs
phv-inseparable.s: Some phrasal verbs are **inseparable**: the object always goes **after** the particle, even a pronoun (*look after **her***, *come across **it***). Some have **no object** at all: *get up, grow up, break down*.
phv-inseparable.b0.0.2: *She **looks after** her grandma. She looks after **her**.*
phv-inseparable.b0.3.1: enter / leave a bus or train
phv-inseparable.b1: With inseparable verbs, never put the object in the middle: *look after **the baby*** (not *look the baby after*).
phv-inseparable.b2: ***Grow up*** has no object. To raise children, use ***bring up***: *She **brought up** three children.*
x.phv-separable-s01: Pronoun in the middle: *turn it down*.
x.phv-separable-s02: Pronoun in the middle: *give it back*.
x.phv-separable-s03: Pronoun in the middle: *put them away*.
x.phv-basic-b05: Stop a machine: *turn off* (or *turn down* = less loud).
x.phv-basic-b07: *Go out* = leave home to have fun.
x.phv-separable-b01: Pronoun in the middle: *throw them away*.
x.phv-separable-b02: Pronoun in the middle: *wake me up*.
x.phv-separable-b03: Pronoun in the middle: *try them on*.
x.phv-separable-b04: A noun can go after the particle: *fill in this form*.
x.phv-separable-b05: Pronoun in the middle: *fill it in*.
x.phv-separable-b07: Pronoun in the middle: *hang it up*.
x.phv-separable-b09: Pronoun in the middle: *call you back*.
